title: Urology and Continence Supply Program: tenure addition to an HMO payment plan term
content:
A payment plan for the balance of a Continence Commercial HMO Program of the Urology and Continence Supply Program receives a tenure addition. The addition is set by how long ago the program became active.

## Addition

| Program became active, in whole calendar months before the plan is accepted | Months added to the term |
|---|---|
| 24 or more | 2 |
| at least 12 but fewer than 24 | 1 |
| fewer than 12 | none |

Whole calendar months are counted from the program's activation date to the acceptance date, with a partial month not counted.

*Hypothetical:* a program activated on 5 March 2024 and a plan accepted on 4 March 2026 give 23 whole months, so 1 month is added. Accepted on 5 March 2026, the count is 24 whole months, so 2 months are added.
